note: Decisions about dormant rules — never fired in the audit window, older than the minimum age, pinned by no mechanical case. A retained rule leaves the undisposed count until its review falls due, counted in runs; deletion and merging need no entry because the rule leaves the catalog. Reasons are per category and each category is a claim a later round can falsify.
